d: Step inside the sacred Mahakaleshwar Temple in Ujjain — the only south-facing Jyotirlinga of Shiva. This HistoryTV18 documentary captures rare rituals like the pre-dawn Bhasma Aarti, where sacred ash is offered to the Shivling, and the Jal Abhishekam, a cleansing water offering performed before sunrise. Witness the elaborate Maha Poojan on Mahashivratri, where the deity is bathed in Panchamrit and adorned with a unique floral sehra.
